messages:
support_jess: Heads-up — several customers filed tickets saying per-model throughput charts in the Console are showing flatlines (no datapoints) for certain models since yesterday afternoon. Repro on our side: dashboards show empty series for model IDs that definitely had traffic.
eng_platform_omar: Thanks Jess. Which dashboards / which models? Any affected regions?
support_jess: Affected: /models/<model-id>/throughput and the per-model tile on the ‘Model health’ page. Examples: rwd-7b-chat, rwd-2.7-embed. Regions: us-west-2 primarily. Happened ~ 2026-06-10 16:00 UTC.
metrics-bot: Alert: metric_series_zero_count increase for "redwood_model_throughput" at 2026-06-10T16:02:14Z.
eng_ml_raj: Oncall, can you dump the raw metric timeseries from Prometheus for rwd-7b-chat? I want to see if metric exists but labels changed.
oncall-bot: @eng_ml_raj oncall pager duty rota: raj is oncall for eng-ml this week.
eng_ml_raj: Running query: 
```
# promql
sum by(model,region) (rate(redwood_model_throughput[5m]))
```
Result: series count dropped to 0 for several models. But raw metric still shows data if I query without 'model' label.
eng_platform_omar: Wait — you're saying the metric has data but the label key is missing/renamed? Can you show raw sample points?
eng_ml_raj: Example output (scrubbed):
```
redwood_model_throughput{model_name="rwd-7b-chat",region="us-west-2"} 12.3
redwood_model_throughput{model_name="rwd-2.7-embed",region="us-west-2"} 4.1
```
But dashboards/old queries expect label 'model' not 'model_name'. So the dashboard `group by model` returns nothing.
support_jess: That would explain it. Any recent infra/metrics change? Customer-facing bug started right after a metric migration ticket was scheduled yesterday.
eng_platform_omar: I deployed a relabel transformation in the metrics pipeline yesterday to standardize label names (we migrated `model` -> `model_name` across services). It was intended to be backwards-compatible but I apparently removed the old label rather than copy it. 
product_liz: Oof — we should have coordinated. Which dashboards are impacted besides per-model throughput?
eng_platform_omar: Probably anything filtering on `model`. Search panels that explicitly filter `model` will break. Console rolls up per-model tokens, latencies, error rates.
eng_ml_raj: Temporary mitigation: update dashboard queries to OR on both labels, e.g. 
```
(sum by(model) (rate(redwood_model_throughput[5m])))
or
(sum by(model_name) (rate(redwood_model_throughput[5m])))
```
But Grafana doesn't like mixing label names — better to use label_replace to normalize in-query: 
```
label_replace(sum by(model_name) (rate(redwood_model_throughput[5m])), "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)")
```
eng_platform_omar: I'm going to roll back the relabel staging change to reintroduce `model` until we push dashboard updates. Rolling back now.
eng_platform_omar: (runs deployment) 
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/metrics-relabeler
# apply previous relabel config: keep both model and model_name
```
eng_platform_omar: Rolled back relabeler to previous config that preserves `model` label.
metrics-bot: Metric freshness restored for redwood_model_throughput at 2026-06-10T16:34:05Z.
support_jess: Confirmed in Console UI: per-model throughput tiles are back-populated for the earlier example models. Customers notified.
product_liz: Thanks for the quick rollback. We'll need a postmortem and an action plan so this doesn't reoccur.
eng_ml_raj: Quick action items: 1) Update dashboards to be label-robust (use label_replace or normalized view). 2) Add CI check for metrics relabel migrations that verifies dashboards queries after change. 3) Create a migration window + announce to Console/dashboard owners.
eng_platform_omar: Agreed. I'll open an infra PR to make the relabeler write both labels for a 7-day dual-write period, with a follow-up to remove `model` after dashboards are updated.
product_liz: Assign owners and ETA?
eng_platform_omar: I'll own the relabeler PR, target EOD 2026-06-11 to have dual-write. Raj will help update the most-used dashboards first (ETA 6/12). Jess will coordinate customer comms.
support_jess: Got it. I'll update the affected tickets with repro, root cause (label rename removed old label), and ETA for final fix.
eng_ml_raj: Adding retrospective note: prefer running a cross-team test that queries dashboards live after metric key changes. Saves a lot of twitching. :thumbsup:
support_jess: Closing the slack thread; will reopen if any regression. Thanks everyone.
